description: Roll a session back to a checkpoint from commit_session: every cell edit made after it is undone, calc settings included, and the workbook is recalculated. Use it to throw away a what-if or a bad edit; it rewinds this session only and can't reopen a closed one. Returns {restored_to, cells_changed, calc, recalc}. A commit_id the session doesn't have fails the call. To compare two states without rolling back, export each with export_workbook and use diff_workbooks.

commit_id.description: Commit ID to restore to (from commit_session)

session_id.description: Session ID returned by create_session (list_sessions shows the open ones)

name: restore_session
title: Restore session
